test_case.test_name: AMD OOB XGMI link1 correctable BER ext6 CPER validation
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved XGMI link1 correctable BER event yields an attributable ext6 corrected CPER and leaves both link endpoints and the whole fabric healthy.
required_package: All GPU UUID/OAM/BDF and link1 endpoint topology
Authenticated paginated Systems/UBB Dump endpoint and schema
BER quiet-window/all-peer oracle and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator preserves full Dump and all-link baseline, runs `amdgpuras -b 7 -l`, validates both link1 endpoints, executes `sudo amdgpuras -b 7 -m 6 -t 2 -s 1` once, obtains and hash-verifies the unique new CPER, decodes OAM/XGMI/ext6/BERExceededErr/corrected fields, then checks both endpoints and every fabric peer through the approved quiet window.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one attributable corrected XGMI CPER matches the selected OAM/link context and ext6 BERExceededErr; no fatal escalation, recurring BER or peer degradation remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved topology/tool semantics, one injection, unique artifact, exact decoded fields, all-link quiet oracle and healthy recovery. Ambiguous entry, wrong endpoint, fatal severity, storm or degraded peer fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle multi-GPU SUT and explicit fabric-injection approval.
Confirm both link1 endpoints before command execution.
Preserve complete Redfish baseline; never infer latest entry from max ID alone.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Pre/post paginated Dump inventories and attachment hashes
Link enumeration and single exact command output
All-peer quiet-window and final GPU/BMC/host health
test_case.recovery: On wrong link, fatal escalation, BER storm, peer loss or connectivity failure, stop and preserve evidence; invoke approved OOB fabric/GPU/host recovery only and verify every peer before any separately authorized rerun.
